annotations.title: utilpeek: convert subtitles between SRT, WebVTT and JSON

description: utilpeek: Convert SRT, WebVTT and JSON subtitles; scale or shift timing. To make subtitles from audio use transcribe_audio. Returns SRT, WebVTT or JSON segments [{start, end, text}] in seconds, with optional timing scale and shift. Cue bounds and WebVTT inline timestamps map to round(ms * time_scale) + shift_ms, ties to even. At most 1,000,000 characters and 10,000 cues. Malformed input is a 422, not charged. Starts clamp at 0; with a negative shift, cues ending at or before 0 are dropped. Times past 99:59:59.999 are refused. Typically under 0.3 s. Price: USD 0.002. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/subtitle-converter-api.html

end.description: End in seconds, not before start.

content.description: The SRT or WebVTT file as text (at most 1,000,000 characters, 10,000 cues). The format is detected from a WEBVTT header unless from_format is given. Use this or segments.

from_format.description: Input format check: content is srt or vtt, segments are json.

segments.description: A JSON segment list [{start, end, text}] in seconds, as /v1/audio/transcribe returns it. Use this or content.

shift_ms.description: Time shift in milliseconds, after scaling (negative = earlier; cues ending at or before 0 are dropped).

time_scale.description: Timing multiplier, 0.5 to 2.0; default 1. Cue bounds and WebVTT inline timestamps become round(ms * time_scale) + shift_ms; ties round to even.

to.description: Output format: srt (SubRip), vtt (WebVTT) or json (a list of {start, end, text}, seconds).

name: convert_subtitles

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
